steps.what: Review available campaign resources, media options and public commitments
Determine strategies for advertising, issue positions and public appearances
Write the chosen strategy in the existing campaign plan
Communicate the final plan to campaign colleagues

tasks.design: Use native campaign-document views and stable plan headings in {DOCS}. The legislator determines the strategy, separately writes it and communicates the exact plan to colleagues; no model recommends political positions or audience persuasion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation and plan structure consume a small share of strategy work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and fixed document headings can remove these mechanical operations.
tasks.still_hard: Political priorities, public commitments and trade-offs remain accountable human decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Choose and explain a coherent course of action.
tasks.altitude: Reduce plan handling while retaining strategy authorship.

reach.task: Work from the chosen campaign direction
reach.learn: Keep operational activity consistent with stated commitments

evidence.claim: Native document views and reusable headings can reduce repeated plan handling; this is an unmeasured E1 design.

assumptions: The campaign already uses a written plan read by colleagues. No separate decision log or extra public communication is invented.
The legislator produces resource constraints in s1 and decisions and qualifications in s2-s3; capture is counted. Missing information is investigated manually.
The native view removes 2 retrieval hours; stable headings remove 2.5 of 25 writing hours. Substantive strategy writing and decisions remain fully human.
Ordinary author saves have no approval stage. Public advertising placement and appearances are implementation tasks, not implied machine actions in this strategy design.
research_questions: Which repeated plan operations remain manual today?

already_counted.description: Write and communicate the chosen strategy

incremental.description: Maintain the plan structure as campaign work changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact final plan version and colleagues receiving the direction; changed decisions require reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=95.5, gross 4.5 less 1 upkeep gives 3.5 net. Conservative case: current document access is already direct and only one hour of plan structure is reusable, offset by one upkeep hour. With usable revision metadata removing one search hour and stable headings removing two writing hours, 97 hours remain and one upkeep gives 2 net. No strategy decision time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Discuss candidates' concerns and provide personal encouragement
Write existing messages of support for candidates
Check and send the final support message
Attend activities and provide the personal support committed to candidates

tasks.design: Retain personal encouragement and participation. Reuse only stable message structure in {DOCS}; the legislator writes the actual support and checks the exact final content and recipient before sending through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated salutation, signature and message formatting take time in existing written support.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can remove that formatting without generating political advocacy.
tasks.still_hard: Support requires personal commitment, judgement and relationships.
tasks.human_edge: Offer credible encouragement and follow through on commitments.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated message formatting while retaining personal support.

reach.learn: Distinguish actual commitments from general encouragement

evidence.claim: Fixed document structure can reduce formatting of existing correspondence without writing its substantive political content.

assumptions: This portfolio already includes written support messages and personal participation. No supporter database, follow-up log or public endorsement record is introduced.
The legislator produces the actual commitment during s1-s2 and verifies recipient and content in s3; capture is counted. Uncertain commitments are clarified manually.
The template removes 2 of 20 hours of formatting, retaining all personal wording, checking and sending. It does not generate targeted persuasion or rank candidates.

Conversation with same-party colleagues is internal; s3 covers a message delivered beyond the legislator's immediate organisation or publicly. The author save needs no separate gate and the fixed template adds no recurring administration.
unknowns: Existing use of signatures and message templates
research_questions: Is two hours of repeated formatting present in the stated written-message baseline?

already_counted.description: Write substantive support and check the final message before sending

incremental.description: No new recurring work for a fixed native message template

approvals.approved_version: The actual support commitments spoken to the candidate; changed commitments require reconsideration
Exact final message, support commitment and recipient; any revision voids the send decision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=98 and zero upkeep gives 2 net. Conservative case: message formatting is already automatic, retaining all 100 hours. Where a compatible existing template removes one formatting hour, 99 hours remain and 1 net is possible. Personal encouragement, substantive wording, sends and participation remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Establish local offices and manage staff

steps.what: Determine local office requirements and select a workable arrangement
Prepare the existing office setup request and arrangement documents
Check and submit the final office arrangement to the provider
Arrange and check the physical office setup
Decide staff responsibilities and office coverage
Write responsibilities and coverage into the existing office work plan
Communicate the work plan to office colleagues
Manage office staff and resolve ongoing work problems

tasks.design: Reuse the existing office arrangement form and staff work-plan structure in {DOCS}, with the actual provider submission separately checked and sent through {EMAIL}. Establishing the physical office and subsequently managing staff remain distinct human phases.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated setup-form and staff-plan structure consumes document time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can remove that repetition without selecting premises or assigning staff autonomously.
tasks.still_hard: Access, resource constraints and staff concerns require local judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Create a usable office and manage people fairly.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated office paperwork while preserving management responsibility.

reach.learn: Keep responsibility decisions separate from communication

evidence.claim: Native forms and work-plan templates can remove repeated document structure; no local effect is measured.

assumptions: Setup documents are existing forms read by the office provider; the staff plan is already used by colleagues. No new premises register, staff monitoring or activity log is introduced.

The legislator produces premises, cost and access fields in s1-s2 and colleague, responsibility and coverage fields in s5-s6. Capture is counted; missing terms or availability require manual clarification.
The office form removes 1.5 of 15 repeated setup-writing hours. The staff-plan structure removes 2 of 10 heading and stable-field hours. Each retains all case-specific decisions and writing.
These shares cover a mixed office-establishment and staff-management portfolio; they are not weekly frequencies. Ordinary author saves are retained without self-approval.
unknowns: Actual mix of establishment and ongoing staff management
research_questions: Do current office forms and staff plans contain the specified manually repeated structure?

already_counted.description: Write existing setup documents and staff responsibilities

incremental.description: Refresh setup and work-plan templates when arrangements change

approvals.approved_version: Exact final office arrangement terms, costs and provider recipient; changes invalidate the submission decision
Exact staff work-plan version and recipients; changed assignments require reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=96.5, gross 3.5 less 1 upkeep gives 2.5 net. Conservative case: provider-specific forms prevent reuse and existing staff headings remove only one hour, offset by one upkeep hour. Compatible forms removing one setup hour and stable work-plan structure removing 1.5 hours retain 97.5 hours and 1 upkeep yields 1.5 net. Premises decisions, sends, physical setup and management remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assemble agency evidence and check reporting definitions and periods
Calculate comparable measures of agency activities and efficiency
Evaluate agency structure, efficiency, activities and performance in context
Write the existing evaluation findings from the legislator's judgements

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory prose from the legislator's evaluation
loop.input: Explicit evaluation judgements and checked source passages and measures
loop.check: Legislator verifies numbers, agency qualifications and every cited claim
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported content is removed or written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Agency explanations differ beyond fixed headings

steps.what: Check the findings for comparability and unsupported causal conclusions

tasks.design: Use native source views in {DOCS} and specified comparison formulas in {SPREADSHEET}. The legislator evaluates the agency; a bounded loop assists the existing written findings, with source and causal checks retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated evidence navigation, table arithmetic and findings assembly consume evaluation preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit formulas and bounded prose drafting can assist those operations without determining agency merit.
tasks.still_hard: Different mandates, reporting definitions and external constraints make comparisons contestable.
tasks.human_edge: Judge performance in context rather than equate a metric with effectiveness.
tasks.altitude: Reduce mechanical preparation while retaining accountable evaluation.

reach.task: Assess the strength of performance evidence
reach.learn: Distinguish comparable measures from causal claims

evidence.claim: Board Intelligence Report Writer drafts structured papers from management documents; its capability does not establish agency-evaluation accuracy or local savings.

assumptions: The legislator already writes evaluation findings used in subsequent deliberation. No additional report, public send or approval stage is introduced.

The legislator produces agency, period, measure definition, numerator, denominator and source references in s1; capture and comparability checks are counted. Missing definitions force manual comparison.
Native source views remove 5 navigation hours. The 15 calculation hours are actual manual arithmetic to be replaced, not existing spreadsheet runtime.
The drafting loop cannot create the agency judgement in s3. Ordinary same-system author saves remain retained without approval.
unknowns: Comparability of agency reporting periods and definitions
research_questions: Can the comparisons reproduce independently checked tables without masking differences in agency mandates?

already_counted.description: Review the draft and check final comparability and causal claims

incremental.description: Maintain comparison formulas and test drafting against changed reporting formats

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=75.5, gross 24.5 less 3 upkeep gives 21.5 net. Conservative case: non-comparable definitions retain all 25 evidence hours, existing formulas leave only 3 calculation hours removable, and extensive prose correction retains 14 writing hours; other 45 and 3 upkeep give 1 net. Compatible reporting periods could retain 22 evidence, 5 calculation and 11 writing hours plus other 45 and 3 upkeep, giving 14 net. These are distinct baseline and output-quality limitations, not a shared percentage haircut.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
